params.title: GitLab remote
params.initial_input:
mkdir -p /tmp/cmux-ref-tour/gitlab/.git/objects /tmp/cmux-ref-tour/gitlab/.git/refs/heads && cd /tmp/cmux-ref-tour/gitlab && printf '[core]
	repositoryformatversion = 0
	bare = false
[remote "origin"]
	url = git@gitlab.com:manaflow-ai/cmux-reference-fixture.git
	fetch = +refs/heads/*:refs/remotes/origin/*
' > .git/config && printf 'ref: refs/heads/main
' > .git/HEAD && clear; for i in $(seq 60); do echo '#847 #847 #847 #847 #847 #847 #847 #847 '; done
